_doc: Revert-verify mutants for req 5d2c7ede-b053-4dac-a667-7c4f5e4b22da (issue #4516, branch fix-4516-empty-list-null) — the SHARED predicate `emptyPropertyValueForm`. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute; they are committed as placeholders because a machine-absolute path in a committed spec is reported as a DEAD anchor by scripts/check-spec-anchors.mjs). ⛔ The SUBJECT is in packages/core, the AXES in packages/cli — on purpose: no workflow runs jest for packages/services (where the second writer lives) and the cli config is run whole by the required test-coverage-cli, whose moduleNameMapper resolves BOTH @kitelev/exocortex-core and @kitelev/exocortex-services to package SOURCE, so a mutated core file is what the axes exercise. This spec is the one that matters most: it mutates the single definition two writers share, so each mutant reddens axes in BOTH suites at once — which is exactly the property the shared predicate was introduced for.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/utilities/yamlScalar.ts

Y1_empty_list_branch_dead._note: The PRIMARY item of #4516: kills the empty-LIST branch while keeping the expression's SHAPE (`value.length === -1` can never hold, so the branch is unreachable but still type-checks — ITRV §A36/§A97, a compile failure must not be mistakable for a vacuous axis). Reddens the `[]` refusals of BOTH writers at once, which is the whole point of one shared definition.

Y2_null_branch_dead._note: Kills the NULL branch, type-preserving via a sentinel that can never arrive. ⛔ Expected to redden ONLY the writer-3 axes: on the `cli set-property` path `assertScalarOrScalarArray` refuses `null` FIRST with its own message, so E6 (which pins exactly that) stays green. That asymmetry is the measured reason the predicate carries a branch one of its two callers cannot reach.

Y3_list_branch_too_broad._note: The TOO-BROAD half: refuse ANY array instead of an empty one. Reddens only the populated-list controls — the refusal axes pass either way, so without E3/W5 this regression would ship green and silently kill every multi-value write. This is the `integration-test-revert-verify` §A27 trap the issue warned about by name.

Y4_string_branch_widened_to_trim._note: The inherited too-broad half: widening the strict `=== ""` into a trim() test. Reddens only the whitespace controls (E5/W7); the empty-string axes pass either way. 22 live carriers across the three canonical vaults, 2026-10-03 — exo__DisplayNameSpec_separator 13, exo__PrintedLiteral_literal 9.
